values.note: 2026 rates (non-resident): water/electric $43, water/electric pull-through $48, full hookup $53, full-hookup pull-through $58; +$5/night on holiday weekends and special events. Oakland County residents pay $5 less Sunday-Thursday (non-holiday): $38/$43/$48/$53. Monthly: 20% off for 30 consecutive days on one site. $10 fee to change or cancel a reservation.

fees.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/reservations-purchases/groveland-oaks-camping-fees ('Water and Electric: $43/night, Oakland County Residents: $38/night (Sunday-Thursday)' ... 'Full Hookup Pull Through Sites: $58/night'; 'Holidays/Special Events: Additional $5/night') + 2026 fees-and-policies PDF, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/recreation/camping-faqs ('Each standard campsite offers cement or gravel pad with water and electric (20, 30 and 50 amp outlets on each site)') + 2026 camper guide ('Full Hook-Up Sites 6-112'; fees PDF 'Full Hookup - Water, Electric, Sewer'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Pull-throughs: full-hookup sites 1-5 and water/electric sites 127, 129, 131, 133. Also 12 group areas, camping cabins and yurts.

sites.source: https://cdn.oaklandcountymi.gov/oakland-sitefinity-prod/docs/default-source/parks-recreation-docs/parks-trails/groveland-oaks/groveland-camper-guide-2026-web.pdf ('267 campsites'; 'Full Hook-Up Pull-Through Sites 1-5'; 'Water/Electric Pull-Through Sites 127, 129, 131, 133'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://cdn.oaklandcountymi.gov/oakland-sitefinity-prod/docs/default-source/parks-recreation-docs/parks-trails/groveland-oaks/groveland-camper-guide-2026-web.pdf ('Camp store', 'Laundry and free showers', 'WiFi by SkyWeb', 'Dump Station') + camping FAQs ('The sanitary dump station at Groveland Oaks is for Groveland Oaks campers only'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Oakland County Parks WebTrac) or by phone (248-858-1400 / park 248-634-9811), 180 days ahead. 'Reservations that include a Friday or Saturday must be two nights minimum'; holidays three nights. Check-in 3 p.m. (none after 9 p.m.), check-out 1 p.m. Changes and cancellations by phone or in person only.

booking.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/parks-trails/groveland-oaks/camping ('Reservations for campsites, cabins and yurts are accepted 180 days ... in advance'; 'Reservations that include a Friday or Saturday must be two nights minimum'; book online link) + 2026 camper guide ('Weekends require two-night minimum (holidays, three nights)'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/recreation/camping-faqs ('Are there discounts available for campers? Monthly rate discounts apply to a full month of consecutive camping on the same site.'), read 2026-10-22; the military flag came only from the Good Sam directory and the county's own fee pages and FAQ name no military discount

note: Oakland County Parks campground on Stewart Lake, 14555 Dixie Hwy, Holly; concrete or gravel pads, plus camping cabins, yurts and 12 group areas. Swimming beach, mini golf, skate park, paved trails. Daily/annual Oakland County vehicle permit required. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Oakland County Parks' pages: 2026 non-resident $43 (water/electric) to $58 (full-hookup pull-through), resident $5 less Sun-Thu; season May 1 - Oct 5; 20/30/50-amp at every standard site, full hookups at sites 6-112; 267 sites with pull-throughs; showers, laundry, camp store, WiFi, dump; WebTrac or phone, 180 days out, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum. Cleared the Good Sam-directory military flag (county's discount answer names only the monthly rate). Note trimmed of hookup/site/booking/season facts. Currently closed for the season (opens May 1). Reservation line 248-858-1400; park office 248-634-9811 matches.
